flags.title: Way of The Cross
flags.issue: The title casing is wrong: 'The' is capitalised mid-title, and the Kenyan product slug is /product/way-of-the-cross/. The author spelling 'St. Josemaría Escrivá' has a full stop that the description ('St Josemaría') does not use, so the list should settle on one form: St Josemaría Escrivá. The category 'Escrivá' is an author shelf, while every other entry has a subject category. The Kenyan site files devotional titles under Prayer Books, so this belongs under Prayer.

flags.title: In Conversation With God
flags.issue: The description ends with an internal research note ('the Kenyan shop lists six related products'). A reader cannot check it, and it is confusing because the English series runs to seven volumes. The description also repeats the author field. The title casing should have a lowercase 'with'.

flags.title: Reasons For Making A Retreat
flags.issue: The title casing is wrong ('For', 'A'); the slug is /product/reasons-for-making-a-retreat/. The description states the book's promise as fact ('which bring peace, clarity and renewed joy'), so it reads as hype that no one can verify. It should say the book argues this. The author 'David Chandler' could not be re-checked because the search budget ran out, so confirm it before the list ships.

skeptic.summary: I reviewed 4 entries and flagged 4, all as fixes; nothing needs dropping or merging. I found no duplicates and no titles from other publishers (such as the Sceptre imprint or fantasy novels). The fixes are mostly style: title casing on three titles, one spelling of the author as 'St Josemaría Escrivá' with no full stop, and moving Way of the Cross from an author shelf ('Escrivá') to the subject category Prayer. Three descriptions need rewriting: one ends with an internal research note a reader cannot check, one states the book's promise as fact, and one repeats the title and author. Two limits on this review: 1) The WebSearch budget ran out (200 of 200 calls used), so I could not spot-check anything online. The flags rest on the catalogue text, the product slugs given in the brief, and well-known facts about these Scepter titles. The one doubtful point I could not check is 'David Chandler' as author of Reasons for Making a Retreat; confirm it before the list ships. 2) The catalogue is badly incomplete: 4 titles against a shop that says it carries 400+. It has none of the Jacques Philippe, Fulton Sheen or Margaret A. Ogola titles the brief names, and no KSh prices. It is not a usable full list for the Kenya site.
